method: Lead diff is SAME GAME DAY: the 11/16 12:00 AM ET filing against the 11/16 09:15 AM ET filing, matched on a conservative normalised player key inside each matchup and compared on the printed status string. The earlier 11/15 filing is a different game day, so comparing the whole documents would report slate turnover, not injury news; that comparison is published separately and labelled as turnover.
caveat: The whole-document comparison of 11/15 against 11/16 is NOT injury news: the two documents describe different basketball games, so a player simply appears or disappears with the slate. A status change is only reported where BOTH reports list the same player for the same matchup and the printed status string differs. A player who appears in only one of the two documents is reported as newly listed or delisted, never as a status change.
